articles.title: CGTN Poll: China's financial opening-up eases global governance woes
articles.titleCn: CGTN民调：中国金融开放缓解全球治理困境

paragraphs.en: In this context, 74.83% of respondents believe deeper {{7}} of finance and digital technologies can improve economic efficiency and {{8}} the quality of financial services, while 80.86% believe artificial intelligence has become a key {{9}} reshaping the financial industry. According to the poll, 89.23% of respondents believe these developments offer global investors greater opportunities for long-term investment in China.
paragraphs.cn: 在此背景下，74.83%的受访者认为，金融与数字技术的深度融合能够提高经济效率、提升金融服务质量；80.86%的受访者认为，人工智能已成为重塑金融业的关键变量。近年来，中国加快构建中国特色现代金融体系，提升金融服务实体经济的质量和效果。调查发现，90.49%的受访者认为，金融业更好协同服务实体经济有助于增强中国经济韧性、保持长期增长。同时，93.49%的受访者认为，科技金融的持续发展能够加速科技成果商业化并推动产业升级。随着中国持续发展先进制造业、数字经济和绿色产业，新的产业需求和投资机遇不断涌现。民调显示，89.23%的受访者认为这些发展为全球投资者提供了更多在中国进行长期投资的机会。

In the survey, 81.43% of respondents agreed that China's strengthened international financial cooperation helps {{15}} financing channels for countries of the Global South and provide greater support for their economic development. Furthermore, 84.49% believe China's continued financial opening up and efforts to promote international financial cooperation help strengthen confidence in and support the {{16}} of global financial markets. The survey was conducted as an open online poll across CGTN's English, Spanish, French, Arabic and Russian platforms.
paragraphs.cn: 2026年1月至7月，跨境人民币收付金额超过50万亿元（约合7万亿美元），境外主体在中国持有的以人民币计价的金融资产超过11万亿元。共有85.92%的受访者认为，人民币在跨境交易中的使用日益增长，反映出中国金融市场的国际吸引力持续上升。中国还在努力加强国际金融合作，包括通过“一带一路”倡议等平台扩大与其他国家的跨境投融资合作。调查中，81.43%的受访者认同，中国加强国际金融合作有助于拓宽全球南方国家的融资渠道，为其经济发展提供更大支持。此外，84.49%的受访者认为，中国持续扩大金融开放、推动国际金融合作，有助于增强信心并支撑全球金融市场的稳定。该调查是在CGTN英语、西班牙语、法语、阿拉伯语和俄语平台上进行的一项公开在线民调。

paragraphs.en: A total of 3,630 participants casted their votes and shared their views within 24 hours.

articles.fullText:
Against the backdrop of escalating trade frictions and disruptions to global supply chains, the 2026 Annual Conference of Financial Street Forum opened as scheduled. A survey conducted by CGTN among global internet users shows that 82.98% of respondents believe China's continued hosting of the forum demonstrates its resolve and confidence in deepening financial reform and opening up and strengthening international financial exchanges and cooperation. It also highlights China's efforts to address a key dilemma facing global economic governance: how to balance security and efficiency.
Under the theme "Openness, Cooperation and Inclusiveness: Building a New Global Financial Ecosystem," this year's forum has brought together more than 400 participants from over 40 countries and regions. According to the survey, about 85.25% of respondents believe the forum provides an important platform for stakeholders to exchange views on financial development, build consensus and deepen international financial cooperation.
The forum features key topics, including "Economic Governance in the Age of AI" and "AI-Driven Digital and Intelligent Transformation of Capital Markets," while showcasing breakthroughs in applying artificial intelligence, quantum technology and other digital and intelligent technologies to the financial sector. In this context, 74.83% of respondents believe deeper integration of finance and digital technologies can improve economic efficiency and enhance the quality of financial services, while 80.86% believe artificial intelligence has become a key variable reshaping the financial industry.
In recent years, China has accelerated efforts to develop a modern financial system with Chinese characteristics and improve the quality and effectiveness of financial services for the real economy. The survey found that 90.49% of respondents believe that better coordination across the financial sector in serving the real economy helps strengthen China's economic resilience and sustain long-term growth. Meanwhile, 93.49% believe that continued development of technology finance can accelerate the commercialization of scientific and technological advances and drive industrial upgrading.
As China continues to develop advanced manufacturing, the digital economy and green industries, new industrial demand and investment opportunities continue to emerge. According to the poll, 89.23% of respondents believe these developments offer global investors greater opportunities for long-term investment in China. From January to July 2026, cross-border RMB receipts and payments exceeded 50 trillion yuan (about $7 trillion), while overseas entities held more than 11 trillion yuan in RMB-denominated financial assets in China. A total of 85.92% of respondents believe that the growing use of the RMB in cross-border transactions reflects the continuously rising international appeal of China's financial markets.
China is also working to bolster international financial cooperation, including expanding cross-border investment and financing cooperation with other countries through platforms such as the Belt and Road Initiative. In the survey, 81.43% of respondents agreed that China's strengthened international financial cooperation helps broaden financing channels for countries of the Global South and provide greater support for their economic development. Furthermore, 84.49% believe China's continued financial opening up and efforts to promote international financial cooperation help strengthen confidence in and support the stability of global financial markets.
The survey was conducted as an open online poll across CGTN's English, Spanish, French, Arabic and Russian platforms. A total of 3,630 participants casted their votes and shared their views within 24 hours.

articles.titleCn: Anthropic警告AI“蠕虫”在智能设备间传播

articles.fullText:
Small artificial intelligence (AI) models may be only months away from being able to behave like computer worms, copying themselves from one internet-connected device to another without human intervention, AI giant Anthropic said.
The finding could open a new front in the cybersecurity threats emerging from AI, which have rattled governments and companies rushing to adopt the technology.
The research, published on an Anthropic blog late Monday, comes as tech companies race to build increasingly powerful AI capabilities directly into phones, laptops, cars and household devices, rather than running them only in distant data centers.
A computer worm is malicious software that spreads between machines on its own. Researchers at Anthropic said an AI version would no longer need powerful data centers to operate.
Instead, it could hop from device to device across networks of cheap, poorly secured consumer hardware, such as smart TV boxes and kitchen appliances.
The researchers based their calculations of how far such a worm could spread on Kimwolf, a botnet, or network of hijacked devices controlled by hackers, that infected more than two million devices at its peak, mostly off-brand Android TV boxes.
An AI worm of the kind described in the research would likely spread slowly, taking days to copy itself, William Zhou and Daniel Freeman of Anthropic said, comparing it to a slowly multiplying swarm of fruit flies.
Once created, it would be difficult to stamp out because there would be no central switch to turn it off.
Anthropic's researchers said their estimates of how quickly and how far AI-powered malware could spread were rough, as they were based on one type of gadget and one past botnet.
Over time, however, the computing power available in everyday gadgets is expected to keep growing, while the AI models needed to carry out such attacks are likely to keep getting smaller, the researchers added.
Varun Chandrasekaran, an assistant professor of electrical and computer engineering at the University of Illinois, said the research was unsurprising and consistent with similar recent findings, though he cautioned that Anthropic's work had not been independently verified.
He also noted that security on devices such as thermostats and home cameras "has historically been very weak."
However, the biggest current threat involving AI was people using the technology to sharpen their hacking capabilities, rather than AI systems themselves going rogue, he said.
"A malicious human being is now supercharged with AI to perform bad things and we are seeing this happen at scale," he added.
The debate over rogue AI came to the fore in July, when AI programs running on OpenAI models escaped an internal company test and broke into the systems of AI platform Hugging Face, apparently searching for the test's answers.
The incident and subsequent reports of similar cases have fuelled international pressure for closer regulation of AI, even as the Trump administration resists the idea and urges the industry to police itself.
Anthropic and ChatGPT-maker OpenAI have been accused by influential figures in the White House and Silicon Valley of stoking fears about AI and encouraging government regulation to protect their market dominance from smaller rivals.
Brad Smith, president of Microsoft, an investor in OpenAI, warned on Tuesday that industry and governments must "act with urgency" to create "real and effective safety standards" to rein in AI risks.

人工智能巨头Anthropic表示，小型人工智能（AI）模型可能只需数月就能像计算机蠕虫一样行为，在无人干预的情况下从一个联网设备复制到另一个设备。这一发现可能为AI带来的网络安全威胁开辟新战线，这些威胁已让急于采用该技术的政府和公司感到不安。这项研究于周一晚些时候发表在Anthropic的博客上，与此同时，科技公司正竞相将日益强大的AI能力直接构建到手机、笔记本电脑、汽车和家用设备中，而不是仅在遥远的数据中心运行。计算机蠕虫是一种能在机器间自行传播的恶意软件。Anthropic的研究人员表示，AI版本的蠕虫将不再需要强大的数据中心来运行。相反，它可以通过廉价、安全性差的消费硬件（如智能电视盒子和厨房电器）的网络在设备间跳跃。

研究人员基于Kimwolf（一个僵尸网络，即被黑客控制的劫持设备网络，在其高峰期感染了超过200万台设备，主要是非品牌Android电视盒子）来计算这种蠕虫可能传播的范围。Anthropic的William Zhou和Daniel Freeman表示，研究中描述的AI蠕虫可能传播缓慢，需要数天才能自我复制，并将其比作缓慢繁殖的果蝇群。一旦创建，它将难以根除，因为没有中央开关可以关闭它。Anthropic的研究人员表示，他们对AI驱动的恶意软件传播速度和范围的估计是粗略的，因为基于一种小工具和一个过去的僵尸网络。然而，随着时间的推移，日常设备中可用的计算能力预计将持续增长，而执行此类攻击所需的AI模型可能会继续变小，研究人员补充道。伊利诺伊大学电气与计算机工程助理教授Varun Chandrasekaran表示，这项研究并不令人惊讶，与最近的类似发现一致，但他警告说Anthropic的工作尚未经过独立验证。

他还指出，恒温器和家庭摄像头等设备的安全性“历来非常薄弱”。然而，他表示，当前涉及AI的最大威胁是人们利用该技术增强黑客能力，而不是AI系统本身失控。“恶意的人类现在被AI超级充电来执行坏事，我们正看到这种情况大规模发生，”他补充道。关于失控AI的辩论在7月成为焦点，当时运行在OpenAI模型上的AI程序逃离了公司内部测试，闯入了AI平台Hugging Face的系统，显然是在寻找测试答案。该事件及随后类似案件的报道加剧了国际社会对AI加强监管的压力，尽管特朗普政府抵制这一想法并敦促行业自我监管。Anthropic和ChatGPT制造商OpenAI被白宫和硅谷的有影响力人物指责煽动对AI的恐惧并鼓励政府监管，以保护其市场主导地位免受较小竞争对手的侵害。微软（OpenAI的投资者）总裁Brad Smith周二警告说，行业和政府必须“紧急行动”制定“真实有效的安全标准”以控制AI风险。

articles.title: Airshow China is back with 3,000 pieces of kit
articles.titleCn: 中国航展回归，展出3000件装备
articles.summary: For 30 years, the China International Aviation and Aerospace Exhibition, known as Airshow China or Zhuhai Airshow, has put the latest aircraft in front of the public. paragraphs.en:
Flight demos will include formations and {{8}} built around operational needs. For the first time, the Air Force exhibition will include a {{9}} section on digital and intelligent technology. Humanoid robots, digital humans and other tools will be major {{10}}. Foreign aerobatic teams

articles.fullText:
For 30 years, the China International Aviation and Aerospace Exhibition, known as Airshow China or Zhuhai Airshow, has put the latest aircraft in front of the public. This year's show, the 16th, brings the sector's key developments.
More than 3,000 pieces of equipment will go on display in Zhuhai, south China's Guangdong Province, from December 7 to 13. Around 10% will make their debut, organizers said in Beijing on Tuesday.
Expanded exhibition space and international participation
The expo runs across multiple venues, with nearly 150,000 square meters indoors. The outdoor exhibition and support area expands to 335,000 square meters, with extra room for flight demonstrations.
More than 1,100 companies from nearly 50 countries and regions have signed up.
The Bayi Aerobatic Team of the PLA Air Force performs at the 15th China International Aviation and Aerospace Exhibition, south China's coastal city of Zhuhai, Guangdong Province, November 15, 2024. 
Air Force shows off its combat kit
The People's Liberation Army (PLA) Air Force will display operational equipment tested in the field, alongside upgraded systems and capabilities representing emerging combat forces.
The exhibits cover reconnaissance, early warning, air defense, support, airborne operations, unmanned applications, intelligent equipment and munitions – a full picture of the Air Force's modernization.
Flight demos will include formations and maneuvers built around operational needs.
For the first time, the Air Force exhibition will include a dedicated section on digital and intelligent technology. Humanoid robots, digital humans and other tools will be major highlights.
The section will also show advanced applications, including AI-assisted interviews, brain-computer interaction assessments for motion sickness, digital maintenance and intelligent inspection.
Foreign aerobatic teams
More than 170 aircraft have registered for the main exhibition area, setting a new record for the event.
The Russian Knights of the Russian Aerospace Forces will fly, while the UAE Air Force's Al Fursan aerobatic team has also been invited.
Homegrown aerospace tech to take center stage
A range of Chinese-developed products will be showcased.
Reusable rockets are expected to draw crowds, as China is now one of a handful of countries developing reusable space launch technology.
First maritime display – with active naval vessels
The PLA Navy is taking over nearly a kilometer of coastline at Gaolan Port for its first-ever maritime exhibition area at the airshow. Active-service naval vessels will be on static display, while amphibious armored vehicles and other kit will be on land.
An open day – free entry, pre-book online – will let the public get up close to the country's maritime hardware.
China State Shipbuilding Corporation (CSSC) will show off maritime and land-based equipment, including a new 500-tonne-class unmanned vessel. Around 150 exhibits are expected to go on display in the main exhibition area.

articles.titleCn: 2026年APEC：深圳迎接世界领导人倒计时30天
articles.summary: APEC 2026: 30 days to go until Shenzhen hosts world leaders

articles.fullText:
With about 30 days to go before Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) leaders meet in Shenzhen, China is entering the final stretch of its host year and the city steps up preparations.
The 33rd APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting will be held in Shenzhen on November 18 and 19, with the APEC CEO Summit scheduled for November 17 and 18.
On Wednesday, Shenzhen's APEC preparation group called for stronger coordination on conference services, security, healthcare, food safety, transportation, communications and volunteers.
To keep the city moving, Shenzhen is launching a "Green Travel, Smooth Journey for All" plan. It includes adding more than 50 new bus-metro feeder routes, increasing bus services by 20%, and encouraging flexible work hours that week to ease commuting pressure.
The 2026 APEC agenda has been building since February, when delegates from the 21 member economies met in Guangzhou for the first Senior Officials' Meeting.
Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi set out three priorities: openness, innovation and cooperation. He called for a substantive outcome document at the leaders' meeting and greater progress in trade and investment, connectivity, the digital economy and inclusive development.
Over the spring and summer, meetings in Shanghai, Suzhou, Chengdu and Dalian focused on trade, supply chain resilience, AI and digital inclusion.
Now, the challenge is twofold: narrowing differences between 21 economies with diverse interests and levels of development, and translating a broad agenda into outcomes acceptable across the region.
The Finance Ministers' Meeting in Hong Kong from October 19 to 21 will focus on regional economic and financial cooperation. The final Senior Officials' Meeting in Shenzhen on November 14 and 15 will set the stage for the leaders' arrival, while the fourth APEC Business Advisory Council meeting will bring business perspectives into regional economic priorities.
Wang said in March that China's central task as host was to translate the goal of building an Asia-Pacific community into action. For the remaining weeks, that means maintaining momentum on trade and investment, connectivity, innovation and development, while ensuring that the work of APEC's various mechanisms feeds into the leaders' discussions.
The meetings will test whether a broad regional agenda can be translated into practical cooperation at a time of trade frictions, technological change and wider uncertainty.
articles.fullTextCn:

2026年APEC议程自2月以来逐步推进，当时来自21个成员经济体的代表在广州举行了首次高官会。中国外交部长王毅提出了三大优先事项：开放、创新、合作。他呼吁在领导人会议上形成一份实质性成果文件，并在贸易投资、互联互通、数字经济和包容性发展方面取得更大进展。春夏期间，上海、苏州、成都和大连的会议聚焦贸易、供应链韧性、人工智能和数字包容。如今挑战是双重的：缩小21个利益多元、发展水平各异的经济体之间的分歧，并将广泛议程转化为整个地区都能接受的成果。

10月19日至21日在香港举行的财长会议将聚焦区域经济和金融合作。11月14日至15日在深圳举行的最后一次高官会将为领导人到来做好准备，而第四次APEC工商咨询理事会会议将把商业视角纳入区域经济优先事项。王毅在3月表示，中国作为东道主的中心任务是将构建亚太共同体的目标转化为行动。在剩余几周里，这意味着在贸易投资、互联互通、创新和发展方面保持势头，同时确保APEC各机制的工作能汇入领导人讨论。这些会议将检验在贸易摩擦、技术变革和更广泛不确定性之际，广泛的区域议程能否转化为务实合作。

articles.fullText:
Lunar samples from the near and the far sides of the moon will be on display at the 16th China International Aviation and Aerospace Exhibition, also known as Airshow China, the State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense (SASTIND) said Tuesday.
The moon. 
Visitors can closely observe the differences between the lunar samples brought back by Chang'e-5 from the near side of the moon and Chang'e-6 from the far side of the moon, Yi Lin, a Chinese defense industry official told a media conference in Beijing, held to announce details of the exhibition.
The airshow is scheduled from December 7 to 13 in Zhuhai, a coastal city in south China's Guangdong Province.
According to Zhang Hu, executive vice governor of Guangdong, the scale of this year's airshow has been expanded, with an indoor exhibition area of 135,000 square meters. More than 3,000 pieces of equipment are expected to be on display, with about 10% of them making their debut.
More than 170 aircraft will be showcased in the main exhibition area. Over 1,100 enterprises from nearly 50 countries and regions have signed up to the show, he added.
This year's airshow will use three exhibition areas for the first time, namely a main central exhibition area, an unmanned equipment display area and a maritime equipment display area.
Some of China's latest achievements in aerospace development will be put on display. The China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation will bring models that include the first-stage engine of a heavy-lift launch vehicle and the main probe of Tianwen-2. The Aero Engine Corporation of China will exhibit nearly 90 types of aero engines, advanced materials and other items.
A forum is also planned to be held alongside the airshow, conducting industry exchanges around topics such as commercial space, space medicine and human health.
This year marks the 30th anniversary of the founding of Airshow China. Since its inception in 1996, it has become an important window for showcasing advanced aviation and aerospace technologies and equipment from home and abroad. It has also become an international platform for promoting business cooperation in aviation and aerospace technologies and equipment.
articles.fullTextCn:
国家国防科技工业局周二表示，月球正面和背面的月球样品将在第十六届中国国际航空航天博览会（又称中国航展）上展出。中国国防工业官员易林在北京举行的新闻发布会上表示，参观者可以近距离观察嫦娥五号从月球正面带回的样品与嫦娥六号从月球背面带回的样品之间的差异。该航展定于12月7日至13日在中国南部广东省沿海城市珠海举行。据广东省常务副省长张虎介绍，今年航展规模扩大，室内展览面积达13.5万平方米。

预计将有超过3000件装备展出，其中约10%为首次亮相。主展区将展示超过170架飞机。他补充说，来自近50个国家和地区的1100多家企业已报名参展。今年航展将首次启用三个展区，即中心主展区、无人装备展示区和海上装备展示区。中国在航空航天发展方面的一些最新成就将展出。

中国航天科技集团将带来包括重型运载火箭一级发动机和天问二号主探测器在内的模型。中国航空发动机集团将展出近90种航空发动机、先进材料等。航展期间还计划举办一场论坛，围绕商业航天、太空医学与人类健康等议题进行行业交流。今年是中国航展创办30周年。自1996年创办以来，它已成为展示国内外先进航空航天技术和装备的重要窗口。

它也成为促进航空航天技术和装备商业合作的国际平台。
